summary: Covera, a YC-backed company, offers an AI-native OS for insurance brokers with agents designed to automate day-to-day servicing tasks. The company claims integration with popular agency management systems and CRMs, aiming to reduce administrative burdens and increase broker efficiency [ev-001].
team: Team size is reported as 2, and the company is marked as hiring by YC [ev-001].
thesis: Covera aims to replace frequent, costly workflows for insurance brokers by providing AI agents that handle tasks like submission intake, carrier quoting, and claims handling, allowing brokers to focus on client advising and selling [ev-001].
why_now: The increasing complexity and volume of insurance broker workflows, coupled with the rising cost of data entry and administrative tasks, make now an opportune time for automation solutions like Covera [ev-001].
